MemoriaHub CLI v1.3.4
Usage: memoriahub folders [options] [command]

Manage the set of folders watched by MemoriaHub

Options:
  -h, --help            display help for command

Commands:
  add [options] <path>  Add a folder to the managed registry
  list [options]        List all registered folders
  remove <id|path>      Remove a folder from the registry (cascade-deletes its
                        file records)
  enable <id|path>      Enable a previously disabled folder
  disable <id|path>     Disable a folder (skipped during sync)
  help [command]        display help for command
